lean.statement: theorem field_projection_origin_lower_bounds (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] [IsSeparated f] (c : Compactification f) (D : Models P) (b : FieldShriekSystem.Laws P D c) (a : Domains P D c) (A : Adjoints P D c b a) (l : FieldExceptionalSystem.Laws P D c b a A) (j : ∀ E : Index P, normalized P D E Y (J P E Y)) (E F : Index P) (h : E ≤ F) (K : N P D E Y) : (∃ m : ℤ, K.obj.IsGE m) ∧ (∃ m : ℤ, ((A.right E).obj ⟨J P E Y, j E⟩).obj.IsGE m) ∧ (∃ m : ℤ, ((scalar P D a h Y).obj K).obj.IsGE m) ∧ (∃ m : ℤ, ((A.right F).obj ⟨J P F Y, j F⟩).obj.IsGE m) ∧ (∃ m : ℤ, ((scalar P D a h X).obj ((A.right E).obj ⟨J P E Y, j E⟩)).obj.IsGE m)

title: Uniform lower bounds for projection inputs
statement: For supplied normalized coefficient units, the five projection inputs have uniform lower cohomological bounds.

proof.text: For an object of N, forget normalization and apply uniformTower_etale_domains to its inverse under the recorded section-preserving realization. Transport the resulting lower bound to the original system through the realization counit, degreewise using homology of this isomorphism.

Apply this argument separately to K, G_E J_E, C_Y K, G_F J_F, and C_X G_E J_E. The right and scalar functors already have values in N, so each object carries the required normalized predicate. The five bounds need not coincide.
